# `loan` commands

## `loan create`

Add a loan, as the anchor Loan Manager does: liability account, interest account, amount borrowed, annual rate, number of payments, frequency, first due date, optional lender, payment account, balloon and escrow. The regular payment is the level payment unless given. Each payment's interest is the balance times the periodic rate (annual rate / payments per year), rounded half to even; the last payment pays exactly the balance left, absorbing the rounding. Creating a loan posts nothing: record the money borrowed into the liability account with a deposit or journal entry.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | account |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/loan.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow loan create --name "Truck loan" --liability-account "Truck Loan" --interest-account "Interest Expense" --principal 25000.00 --annual-rate 6.5 --term-payments 60 --first-payment-date 2026-02-01 --payment-account Checking --reason "New truck loan" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "loan create", "input": {"name": "Truck loan", "liability_account": "Truck Loan", "interest_account": "Interest Expense", "principal": "25000.00", "annual_rate": "6.5", "term_payments": 60, "first_payment_date": "2026-02-01", "payment_account": "Checking"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | Name for the loan, e.g. Truck loan; unique, ignoring case.; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `liability_account` | `--liability-account` | string | yes | no | — | Liability account carrying the balance (other current or long-term liability). Record the money borrowed into it with a deposit or journal entry, as the anchor asks.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `interest_account` | `--interest-account` | string | yes | no | — | Expense or other expense account interest is charged to.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `principal` | `--principal` | string | yes | no | — | Original amount borrowed, e.g. 25000.00.; minimum length 1; maximum length 40 |
| `annual_rate` | `--annual-rate` | string | yes | no | — | Annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5.; minimum length 1; maximum length 40 |
| `term_payments` | `--term-payments` | integer | yes | no | — | Number of payments over the full term, e.g. 60 for five years paid monthly.; minimum 1; maximum 3000 |
| `first_payment_date` | `--first-payment-date` | string | yes | no | — | Due date of payment 1.; minimum length 10; maximum length 10; pattern "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$" |
| `frequency` | `--frequency` | literal["weekly", "biweekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "semiannual", "annual"] | no | no | "monthly" | How often payments fall due. |
| `origination_date` | `--origination-date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Date the loan was taken out. |
| `lender` | `--lender` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Vendor lending the money: the payee on payment checks. |
| `payment_account` | `--payment-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Bank or credit card account payments come from unless `loan pay` names another. |
| `balloon` | `--balloon` | string | no | no | "0.00" | Balloon due with the last payment; 0.00 when the loan pays down fully.; minimum length 1; maximum length 40 |
| `escrow` | `--escrow` | string | no | no | "0.00" | Escrow added to each scheduled payment.; minimum length 1; maximum length 40 |
| `escrow_account` | `--escrow-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Account escrow is paid into (usually an other current asset); required with escrow. |
| `payment` | `--payment` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Regular principal and interest payment from the loan documents; omitted, the level payment computed from the terms. |

## `loan pay`

Pay the next scheduled loan payment with a check (bank account) or card charge (credit card) whose lines split it: principal to the liability account, interest to the interest account, escrow to the escrow account. extra_principal adds principal (the rest of the schedule is recomputed: same payment, fewer payments); extra_only pays principal alone outside the schedule. Void the check to undo the payment. Dry-run is the preview.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/loan.pay` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow loan pay "Truck loan" --reason "December payment" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "loan pay", "input": {"loan": "Truck loan"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `loan` | `LOAN` | string | yes | no | — | Loan, by id or exact name (ignoring case).; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `date` | `--date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Date of the check or charge; omitted, the due date of the next scheduled payment. |
| `from_account` | `--from-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Bank account (writes a check) or credit card (writes a card charge); omitted, the loan's payment account. |
| `number` | `--number` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Check number; omitted, the next one for the bank account. |
| `extra_principal` | `--extra-principal` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Principal paid beyond the schedule. The remaining schedule is recomputed: same payment, fewer payments. |
| `extra_only` | `--extra-only` | boolean | no | no | false | An extra payment outside the schedule (the anchor's 'An extra payment'): only extra_principal is paid, no interest or escrow, and the next scheduled payment stays due. |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

## `loan update`

Change a loan: name, lender, interest, escrow or payment account, escrow amount, rate or regular payment. A new rate without a new payment recomputes the level payment over the payments left.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | account |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/loan.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow loan update "Truck loan" --annual-rate 5.9 --reason "Rate adjusted" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "loan update", "input": {"loan": "Truck loan", "annual_rate": "5.9"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `loan` | `LOAN` | string | yes | no | — | Loan, by id or exact name (ignoring case).; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `name` | `--name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `interest_account` | `--interest-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `lender` | `--lender` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `payment_account` | `--payment-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `annual_rate` | `--annual-rate` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New annual rate in percent; the remaining schedule is recomputed from the balance now owed. |
| `escrow` | `--escrow` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New escrow per scheduled payment. |
| `escrow_account` | `--escrow-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `payment` | `--payment` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New regular principal and interest payment. Omitted with a new rate: the level payment over the payments left. |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Version of the loan this change was decided from (loan show). |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/loan.update`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |
